title: Riftplunge and Sigilworn — two Android games I’m building as a solo developer
author: Alperapps
selftext:
Hi everyone, I’m Alper, the solo developer behind Alperapps. These are two Android games I’ve been working on: Riftplunge focuses on descending through hazards and managing heat; Sigilworn features fantasy combat, classes, dungeons and bosses. iOS versions are on the way.



A little process context: AI tools were used for a limited number of visual assets. The footage comes from actual Android builds running in an emulator, using staged test runs in the games’ own engines. The two gameplay clips were edited together with FFmpeg: 20 seconds per game, followed by a short developer/platform card. AI also helped draft this post.



The video shows Riftplunge first, then Sigilworn. If either interests you, I’d appreciate you trying it. Google Play links and the full video are in the original post. Happy to discuss the development process here.
